def historical_snapshot():
    observed = {'roots': {}, 'files': {}}
    for root_name in history_spec['roots']:
        root = Path(root_name)
        if root.is_symlink() or not root.is_dir():
            observed['roots'][root_name] = {'invalid_root': True}
            continue
        names, invalid = [], []
        for item in root.rglob('*'):
            if item.is_symlink():
                invalid.append(str(item))
            elif item.is_file():
                names.append(str(item))
            elif not item.is_dir():
                invalid.append(str(item))
        observed['roots'][root_name] = {'files': sorted(names), 'invalid_paths': sorted(invalid)}
    for name in history_spec['files']:
        path = Path(name)
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            observed['files'][name] = {'missing_or_nonregular': True}
        else:
            data = path.read_bytes()
            observed['files'][name] = {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha(data)}
    return observed
